journey.name: Phase 2 family flow — parent to child
journey.description: Automated Android journey for the complete family flow: sign up, consent, create two profiles, upload an owned PDF, review generated drafts, approve, assign to a child, enter child mode, finish a lesson in the WebView, and view recorded progress. Uses a synthetic parent account and owned fixtures only.

actions.action: Verify the LessonBooks sign-in screen shows email and password fields and a create account button
Enter android-family@example.test in the email field and SyntheticJourney2026 in the password field
Tap CREATE ACCOUNT and verify the consent screen appears
Tap SAVE CHOICES and confirm the system dialog to grant both consents
Verify the profile creation screen "Who is learning?" appears
Type FoxOne into the Nickname field and tap CREATE PROFILE · YEAR 1
Verify the library screen for FoxOne with an upload button appears
Tap the choose PDF button, select counting.pdf from Downloads, and verify the generating status appears
Wait until three draft lessons for FoxOne appear in the list
Open the first draft lesson and verify the player renders, then go back
Tap APPROVE on the opened draft and verify it shows as approved, then go back
Tap the assign button on the approved lesson and verify it changes to unassign
Tap Add another profile, type OwlTwo in the nickname field and create the second profile
Switch to FoxOne with the child switcher and verify FoxOne's lessons are listed
Tap Child play and verify the child play view lists the assigned lesson first
Open the assigned lesson and complete all five activities in the WebView until the completion card with a score appears
Go back, exit child play, and verify the parent dashboard shows a progress card with at least one completed lesson
